sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL - AI Wiki
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 -VL is a series of open-weight vision-language models released on 26 January 2025 by the Qwen team at Alibaba (Alibaba Cloud), succeeding the earlier Qwen2-VL family. [1] [2] The series initially launched in 3B, 7B, and 72B parameter sizes, with a 32B variant added on 24 March 2025. sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL-7B Vision-Language Model
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-VL-7B is a mid-scale, open-weight vision-language model that integrates dynamic resolution processing and native temporal encoding. Its architecture combines a vision transformer encoder, a Qwen2.5-based language decoder, and an MLP merger for efficient multimodal reasoning.
